description: The host link as the real peers speak it. A Rust test (hosts.rs welcome, the fake host agent, module_reply), the host agent tests (host_link_fixture.test.ts, and fake_service.ts welcomes from it) and the skill tests (test_host_link_fixture.py) all read it. Change an entry and both peers tests must pass: the real producer of each frame is checked against it, and the fake on the other side is built from it.

module_replies.name: speak while the caller is with another session

body.detail: the caller is listening to another session; use request_to_speak with the actual words they should hear. While in the background, displays are held until the caller brings you forward; never say a display is on screen.

result.detail: the caller is listening to another session; use request_to_speak with the actual words they should hear. While in the background, displays are held until the caller brings you forward; never say a display is on screen.

module_replies.skill_line: switchboard.speak: The caller is on other work; nothing was played. If it matters to them, send it with request_to_speak.

module_replies.name: display from a leg off the call

body.detail: this leg is no longer on the call: stop retrying, nothing you send reaches the caller

reply.reason: this leg is no longer on the call: stop retrying, nothing you send reaches the caller

result.detail: this leg is no longer on the call: stop retrying, nothing you send reaches the caller
